questions.explanation:
Cd(OH)2(s) ⇌ Cd2+(aq) + 2OH(aq)
S 2S

Ksp[Cd(OH)2] = 4(S)3 = 4(1.84 × 10–5)3 [Given S = 1.84 × 10–5]

For buffer solution of pH = 12 :
As pH = 12 so pOH = 2
[OH] = 10-2
Let the solubilty = S1

Cd(OH)2(s) ⇌ Cd2+(aq) + 2OH(aq)
S1 2S1 + 10-2

Ksp[Cd(OH)2] = S1(10-2)2 = 4(1.84 × 10–5)3
S1 = 2.49 × 10–10 M
